mapper.select: SELECT U.USR_ID AS usrId , U.NCK_NM AS usrNm , U.USR_NM AS userName , U.PRFL_IMG_FIL_SEQ AS profileImageFilSeq , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_POST P WHERE P.USR_ID = U.USR_ID AND P.POST_STAT = #{postActive}) AS postCount , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = U.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT = #{followAccepted}) AS followerCount , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = U.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT = #{followAccepted}) AS followingCount , EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{viewerUsrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = U.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT = #{followAccepted} ) AS following FROM TB_USR U WHERE U.USR_ID = #{usrId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMM_FOLLOW ( FOLLOWER_USR_ID, FOLLOWING_USR_ID, FOLLOW_STAT, FRST_REG_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{usrId}, #{followingUsrId}, #{followStat}, #{usrId} ) ON CONFLICT (FOLLOWER_USR_ID, FOLLOWING_USR_ID) DO UPDATE SET FOLLOW_STAT = EXCLUDED.FOLLOW_STAT WHERE TB_COMM_FOLLOW.FOLLOW_STAT <> EXCLUDED.FOLLOW_STAT
mapper.select: SELECT U.USR_ID AS usrId , U.NCK_NM AS usrNm , U.PRFL_IMG_FIL_SEQ AS profileImageFilSeq , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_POST P WHERE P.USR_ID = U.USR_ID AND P.POST_STAT = #{postActive} ) AS postCount , EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F2 WHERE F2.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{usrId} AND F2.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = U.USR_ID AND F2.FOLLOW_STAT = #{followAccepted} ) AS following FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F JOIN TB_USR U ON U.USR_ID = CASE WHEN #{relationType} = 'followers' THEN F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID ELSE F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID END WHERE F.FOLLOW_STAT = #{followAccepted} AND ( (#{relationType} = 'followers' AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = #{usrId}) OR (#{relationType} = 'following' AND F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{usrId}) ) ORDER BY U.NCK_NM, U.USR_ID LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMM_POST ( POST_SEQ, USR_ID, POST_TTL, POST_CN, POST_STAT, VIS_TYP, POST_DTM, FRST_REG_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{postSeq}, #{command.usrId}, NULL, #{command.content}, #{postStat}, #{command.visibility}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{command.frstRegUserId} )
INSERT INTO TB_COMM_POST_FILE ( POST_SEQ, FIL_SEQ, SORT_ORD, MEDIA_TYP, FRST_REG_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{postSeq}, #{filSeq}, #{sortOrder}, #{mediaType}, #{command.frstRegUserId} )
mapper.select: SELECT PF.FIL_SEQ AS filSeq , COALESCE(M.MEDIA_NM, PF.MEDIA_TYP) AS mediaType , COALESCE(C.CONTENT_TYPE, D.CONT_TYP) AS contentType FROM TB_COMM_POST_FILE PF JOIN FIL_DTL D ON D.FIL_SEQ = PF.FIL_SEQ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COM_DTL_CD, COM_DTL_NM AS MEDIA_NM FROM ysc.TB_COM_CD_DTL WHERE COM_CD = 'MEDIA_TYP' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) M ON M.COM_DTL_CD = PF.MEDIA_TYP LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COM_DTL_CD, COM_DTL_NM AS CONTENT_TYPE FROM ysc.TB_COM_CD_DTL WHERE COM_CD = 'CONT_TYP' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) C ON C.COM_DTL_CD = D.CONT_TYP WHERE PF.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} ORDER BY PF.SORT_ORD

SELECT C.CMT_SEQ AS cmtSeq , C.PARENT_CMT_SEQ AS parentCmtSeq , C.USR_ID AS usrId , U.NCK_NM AS usrNm , U.PRFL_IMG_FIL_SEQ AS profileImageFilSeq , C.CMT_CN AS cmtCn , TO_CHAR(C.CMT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS cmtDtm , (C.CMT_STAT = 'DELETED') AS deleted FROM TB_COMM_CMT C JOIN TB_USR U ON U.USR_ID = C.USR_ID WHERE C.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} AND C.CMT_STAT IN ('ACTIVE', 'DELETED') ORDER BY C.CMT_DTM
